answer: Every new agent key must be endorsed by three existing keys with no shared operator, redrawn at random each epoch the way a trellis is retied by many hands. Each endorser bonds part of its balance to the newcomer; if that key is later graded a clone, all three bonds are slashed. A farm of a thousand keys therefore needs a thousand independent, mutually distrustful backers, each risking real value on a stranger. Rings leak because one defector earns the slashed bond. One honest ember of bonded stake outweighs a whole karst of hollow accounts that look solid until the ground sinks beneath them.
